title: JAX-WAVE: A Differentiable Physics-Supervised Framework for Inverse Wave Design in Heterogeneous Media
abstract: arXiv:2611.13826v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Designing a prescribed wave field in a heterogeneous medium requires an initial pressure distribution that compensates for the medium's propagation response. Repeated numerical inversion solves this task afresh for each target and environment. We introduce JAX-WAVE for amortized inverse wave design: a shared neural network maps desired terminal fields and known wave-speed maps directly to bounded initial pressures. Training through a differentiable finite-difference time-domain solver uses the physical design objective without requiring optimized control labels. Linear propagation and symmetric pressure bounds imply an exact sign-reversal relation for the regularized optimum. A shared-weight projection enforces this relation, preserves feasibility, and satisfies an exact identity for the paired-sign objective. translated_title: JAX-WAVE：面向非均匀介质中逆波场设计的可微分物理监督框架
translated_abstract: 在非均匀介质中设计一个指定的波场，需要一种能够补偿介质传播响应的初始压力分布。传统的重复数值反演方法需要针对每个目标和环境重新求解该任务。我们提出了 JAX-WAVE 用于摊销式逆波场设计：一个共享神经网络将期望的末端波场和已知的波速分布图直接映射到有界的初始压力。训练过程通过可微分的时域有限差分（FDTD）求解器进行，直接使用物理设计目标，而无需依赖优化得到的控制标签。线性传播和对称压力界意味着正则化最优解存在精确的符号反转关系。一个共享权重的投影机制强制执行这一关系，保持解的可行性，并满足配对符号目标的精确恒等式。我们刻画了离散传播算子及其加权伴随算子，从而将学习、数值反演和最优性评估联系起来。
tldr: 提出可微分物理监督框架 JAX-WAVE，通过共享神经网络与可微分时域有限差分求解器实现摊销式逆波场设计，无需优化控制标签即可将目标波场直接映射为满足符号反转等物理约束的最优有界初始压力。
en_tdlr: JAX-WAVE is a differentiable physics-supervised framework that amortizes inverse wave design by training a shared neural network through a differentiable FDTD solver, mapping desired fields directly to bounded optimal initial pressures without requiring optimized control labels.
